candidates.title: 2 more people have died exploring Banff National Park, police say
candidates.description: A 24-year-old climber died after a significant fall from Recondite Peak in Banff National Park on Wednesday, while a 33-year-old hiker died on Saturday near Devil's Thumb and the Big Beehive area by Lake Louise, according to police.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Flair Airlines secures $76M bailout from Ottawa as fuel costs soar
candidates.description: The federal government has approved $76 million in emergency aid for Flair Airlines as the high price of jet fuel continues to bleed money from carriers.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Jazz Aviation reaches tentative deal with flight attendants
candidates.description: Canadian discount airline Jazz Aviation says it has reached a new tentative contract with the union representing its flight attendants.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Sask. man, 58, pleads guilty to incest for repeated sexual assaults of his daughter
candidates.description: A man who pleaded guilty to sexual assault and incest cannot be identified to protect the identitities of his victims. He was from a community west of Saskatoon.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Flare-ups, smoke still expected as P.E.I. solar farm fire continues into second week
candidates.description: The fire at the Summerside Sunbank solar farm remains active as it enters its second week, with flare-ups expected and smoke still possible in the area.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: N.L. spent $1.1M on forensic audit of travel nurse agency payments, findings remain off limits to public
candidates.description: Newfoundland and Labrador health officials are keeping details of an external forensic audit of payments made to a travel nursing agency under wraps — at least for now.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Tsawwassen First Nation welcomes back sacred object taken away a century ago
candidates.description: Sqəmáθia, a rock sculpture of a person about a foot and a half tall, was flown home from the Canadian Museum of History in Quebec.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Leg injury forces Gabriel Diallo to withdraw from Canada's Davis Cup tie against France
candidates.description: Gabriel Diallo withdrew from Canada's upcoming Davis Cup tie against France due to a leg injury, Tennis Canada said Monday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Reef balls are turning an ocean desert in N.L. into a thriving ecosystem
candidates.description: Last year, fisheries technologist Mark Santos and a team at the Marine Institute launched 285 cement reef balls into Placentia Bay’s Fox Harbour in a bid to remediate an ocean dead zone. Already, he said, they can see marine life returning.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Manitoba woos investors with tax break to help fund Port of Churchill expansion
candidates.description: Manitoba is sweetening the pot for investors thinking of putting their money into the proposed Port of Churchill expansion by offering an exemption on the provincial sales tax.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: No smart glasses, no cameras: Toronto venues rethink privacy on the dance floor
candidates.description: A Toronto music venue has taken the step to publicly ban smart glasses, while other venues are reconsidering phone use that can make private moments public on social media. But while some owners want to return to a more old school vibe, others say new technology is key to their marketing.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'Elbows Up': Canadian companies trying to cash in on patriotic slogan
candidates.description: From the hockey rink to the political arena, the phrase "Elbows Up" has become part of the Canadian lexicon — and now a number of businesses are trying to cash in on it.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Treaty 6 band members share mixed feelings on Alberta's referendum at 150th anniversary gathering
candidates.description: As hundreds of people from across the Prairies recently gathered to mark a century and a half since the signing of Treaty 6, many attendees considered what the agreement will mean for future generations as Albertans prepare to vote in a referendum on whether the province should remain part of Canada or hold a binding referendum on seeking independence.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: PQ leader points to high immigration for school and housing crises. Is he right?
candidates.description: Parti Québécois Leader Paul St-Pierre Plamondon is calling for lower immigration levels, arguing that soaring population growth has directly fuelled the housing crisis and overcrowding in schools. But CBC spoke with experts who say it’s far more complicated than that.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Surrey, B.C., man awarded $275K after 77-day-long protest in front of his home
candidates.description: Yun Fei Zhu, the group "leader," was found to have made and published defamatory statements against Bing Chen Gao, a journalist and outspoken critic of the Chinese Communist Party.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Dawson shooting survivor turned SPVM officer reflects on friend's death 20 years on
candidates.description: Two decades ago, James Santos saw his friend die in a shooting at a Montreal college. Now he is a Montreal police officer working for the force he says saved his life that day.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Lobster fishing contest in memory of P.E.I. teen sees record turnout
candidates.description: Nearly 200 boats hit the water in western Prince Edward Island on Saturday, for a lobster fishing contest honouring an Island teen who died in a boating accident in 2020.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 2 boaters rescued after fishing vessel sinks between B.C.'s Lower Mainland and Vancouver Island
candidates.description: British Columbia's ferry operator says two people were pulled from the waters Sunday afternoon after their fishing vessel sank.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: This Afghan says Canada is abandoning her in a country where it feels like it's a 'mistake' to be a woman
candidates.description: An Afghan woman who hopes to make it to Canada describes worsening conditions for women living under Taliban rule.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Persian Gulf states call off meeting with Iran as Houthis launch new attack on Saudi Arabia
candidates.description: Arab states in the Persian Gulf called off a meeting with Iran planned for Monday, while Yemen's Houthis launched a new attack on Saudi Arabia after fighting that has extended the Middle East war to another theatre and further jeopardized global oil supplies.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Amid Trump trade war, Canada's exports to China up 30% in first half of 2026
candidates.description: The Canada-China Business Council and the University of Alberta's China Institute have crunched the trade data between Canada and China for the first half of 2026, and it shows Canadian exports to China rose by 30.1 per cent to $21.74 billion, while imports from China declined by 5.8 per cent to $44.86 billion.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: European Parliament to open Ottawa office as Carney seeks 'unique alliance' with EU
candidates.description: The European Parliament, a key institution of the European Union, is set to open an "antenna" office in Canada's national capital as Prime Minister Mark Carney looks to deepen ties with the 27-member bloc.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Macklemore cut from Ed Sheeran U.S. tour after onstage 'Free Palestine' remarks
candidates.description: Macklemore has been dropped from the remainder of Ed Sheeran's tour, according to the Rolling Stone, after several venues in the United States said they would not allow the concerts to be held if the American rapper, who is an outspoken Palestinian advocate, remains on the lineup.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Bob Mackie, fashion designer and costumer to the stars, dead at 87
candidates.description: Bob Mackie, the fashion designer whose visually provocative Hollywood style defined glamour for the 1970s — including putting Carol Burnett in some of her kookiest getups and Cher in her raciest ones, died Monday. He was 87.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Sydney Sweeney's 'sexualized' sports betting ad slammed by Canadian athletes
candidates.description: U.S. actor Sydney Sweeney is once again facing backlash over an advertisement. But this time, she's enraged female athletes around the world with a nude sports betting ad — and her response.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Preliminary results suggest a 3-seat majority for opposition as tight Swedish election ends
candidates.description: Sweden may face a long wait for a new government as preliminary election results on Monday showed a thin and still-uncertain lead for the left-leaning opposition. With nearly 95 per cent of districts counted, the Swedish Election Authority reported that the four opposition parties were heading for 176 seats in the 349-seat parliament in Stockholm.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Will the U.S. midterm results affect Trump's tariffs on Canada? Democrats think yes
candidates.description: Although Canada and the United States remain entrenched in their trade war positions, some Democratic politicians say a strong showing for their party in the upcoming U.S. midterm elections in November will make a difference in the fight.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Search underway for about 130 people after Indonesian ferry overturns
candidates.description: A ferry overturned in bad weather in Indonesia's Java Sea on Sunday, leaving about 130 passengers and crew missing, rescuers said. At least 107 people were rescued and the bodies of six passengers were recovered.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Trump decries critics of AI, saying they're 'negative forces' with exaggerated concerns
candidates.description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday likened critics of ‌artificial intelligence to "very negative forces" bringing up scenarios that won't happen, and said he wants to make sure the U.S. remains the industry leader.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Alexander Zverev beats Ben Shelton to win U.S. Open, extending 23-year drought for American men
candidates.description: Alexander Zverev won his second major championship and kept American men without a Grand Slam title since 2003, beating Ben Shelton 6-3, 7-6 (2), 5-7, 6-2 on Sunday in the U.S. Open final.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Departin' from Parton: Nashville International Airport to be renamed in Dolly Parton's honour
candidates.description: It's official. The late Dolly Parton will be gaining a new namesake — and it's taking off. Nashville International Airport in Tennessee is set to be renamed in honour of the celebrated singer, after its board of commissioners voted in favour of the move on Friday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Prince Harry and Meghan's U.K. return gets a very British roast in Saturday Night Live UK sketch

candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Turkish authorities launch crackdown on 2SLGBTQ+ and HIV support groups
candidates.description: Turkish authorities cracked down on multiple 2SLGBTQ+ groups and individuals early Sunday morning, detaining dozens of members, breaking into association offices and raiding popular hangouts.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Iran postpones talks with neighbouring countries; cargo ship near Strait of Hormuz reportedly struck
candidates.description: State-run IRNA news agency quoted the Qeshm governor as blaming a "terrorist enemy" for an attack on a cargo ship near the Strait of Hormuz. The governor also said the person killed was among the vessel's 10-member crew and that authorities had not yet identified the projectile.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Lithuania says drone sighting turns out to be flock of birds, after NATO summons jets
candidates.description: Lithuania said that a perceived drone sighting in its airspace earlier on Sunday that prompted authorities to close Vilnius airport and NATO to summon at least one fighter jet turned out to be a flock of birds.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Israeli strike kills 2 people in Gaza, medics say

candidates.title: 'Cool to be Canadian': Leaders optimistic their pitch to invest here will pay off

candidates.title: Carney is seeking $1 trillion in investments. What will it take to land major deals at this week's summit?

More than 167 major projects are on the table, but what will it take for Canadian leaders to show that the country is committed to building big things?

candidates.title: Canada's inflation holds firm at 3% in August as travel, shelter costs rise

candidates.description: With diesel prices skyrocketing due to ongoing global conflicts, filling up the trucks that carry food and goods across Canada has never been more expensive, experts say — and Canadians could be feeling it soon.

candidates.description: Earlier this year, OpenAI launched a feature on ChatGPT meant to help people at risk of suicide connect with someone they trust for support. But its setup may prove challenging to someone in crisis.

candidates.description: Pennsylvania has announced its third measles-related death in less than three weeks. A local coroner says the 40-year-old woman was unvaccinated.

candidates.description: Actor Tatyana Ali says her healing journey after a traumatic childbirth has inspired her advocacy for Black maternal health, including support for midwives, doulas and other birth workers.

candidates.title: Black women are more likely to experience pregnancy trauma and have their pain ignored
candidates.description: Black mothers in the U.S. are three times as likely to die from pregnancy-related causes than white women. Actress Tatyana Ali became an advocate after her own awful experience giving birth.
